option_relations.rationale: Subcutaneous endometriosis is a broader category that includes abdominal wall endometrioma after cesarean section.
Secondary cutaneous endometriosis (SCE) is a broader category that includes abdominal wall endometrioma after cesarean section, as the latter is a form of secondary cutaneous endometriosis.

Scar (abdominal wall) endometriosis is clinically equivalent to abdominal wall endometrioma after cesarean section, as the vignette describes a mass in the lower-left abdominal region with a linear scar, consistent with scar endometriosis following a cesarean section.
Abdominal wall endometriosis is a broader category that includes abdominal wall endometrioma after cesarean section.
